title: The topological Krull dimension of the spectrum is the Krull dimension of the ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\operatorname{Spec}R$ its set of prime ideals with the Zariski topology [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] (the supremum of the lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets) equals the Krull dimension of the ring $R$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (the supremum of the lengths of chains of prime ideals), as elements of $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$.
